words_to_learn.en: drink yourself out, drink your fill

lines.en: What trouble, hey Jovan,
what heavy trouble you hide in your heart,
what happened to you, hey Jovan,
that you drink so fiercely?

lines.cyr: Ај што пиеш, ај што пиеш,
lines.lat: Aj što pieš, aj što pieš,
lines.en: Oh, what you drink, oh, what you drink,
drink yourself out.
But why do you break down, why do you break down,
hey, what is wrong with you?

lines.cyr: На мака зарем си само ти,
lines.lat: Na maka zarem si samo ti,
lines.en: Is it only you who has trouble,
who has not at least once had
the same sorrows?

lines.cyr: На срце рана имам и јас
lines.lat: Na srce rana imam i jas
lines.en: I too have a wound on my heart,
Jovan, it will pass for us,
come on, let's drink a toast!
Don't go crazy, hey Jovan,
however much the heart hurts.
What is past does not come back,
